Name: Scout
Description: An early-action specialist who seizes the opening of battle with scouted abilities that can only be used as the first action of a wave, then transform into a lesser related ability afterward. He builds aim quickly, attacks enemies at full health for bonus damage, and is difficult to eliminate before he gets to act.
Mechanic: Scouted Abilities — Scouted abilities are more powerful only on the very first action of battle. After use, they downgrade permanently to a lesser version for the rest of that battle. The New Beginning capstone restores the scouted condition mid-battle if the Scout's momentum is high enough, allowing him to use the upgraded version again.
Lore: During the war, the Trader States deployed scouts as the eyes of the Concord advance, mapping Abyssal territory and feeding intelligence back to the supply lines that won the war. Five years later, formal Scout units have largely dissolved, and most have traded military contracts for civilian work — surveyors, guides, pathfinders for merchant expeditions into the Abyssal Lands. The skills transfer cleanly. The pay is worse.
Weapon Mech: initiative bonus, acts sooner in first round
Major 1: Adroit Momentum – Ranged attack with pinpoint and momentum enhancing accuracy
Major 2: Aimed Momentum – Ranged attack that generates extra aim based on momentum
Major 3: Coordinated Shot – Ranged attack with quick preparation that grants increased accuracy and damage to next attack versus target
Major 4: Delaying Jolt – Ranged attack with delay against stunned target
Major 5: Flanking Shot – Ranged attack that causes flanked
Major 6: Lay of the Land – Ranged attack that enhances dodge of team based on aim
Major 7: Quickening Aim – Ranged attack against single target that consumes aim to quicken self
Major 8: Rapid Vow – Prepared ranged attack that determines target on preparation.  Quickens scout on preparation and on use
Major 9: Scouted Arrow Burst – Ranged attack against all enemies.  Deals less damage and requires aim if not first turn
Major 10: Scouted Chink – Full penetration ranged attack if first attack of battle.  Can proc full penetration with ranged attack after
Major 11: Scouted Shot – Ranged attack with momentum.  Generates aim if first turn
Major 12: Speed Shot – Ranged attack that requires momentum and grants aim and deals extra damage based on momentum
Major 13: Sudden Shot – Ranged attack with sudden
Major 14: Supplemented Shot – Ranged attack.  Causes the target to take damage on the next x times it misses.  Consumes aim
Move 1: Aimed Pursuit – Follows hit, quickens ally and enhances accuracy based on aim on target
Move 2: Danger Warning – Grants all allies enhanced dodge until next turn
Move 3: Momentum Arrow – Ranged attack requiring momentum
Move 4: Scouted Positions – Flanks and delays all enemies as first action.  Otherwise flanks and delays single enemy
Move 5: Scouted Preparations – Provides initial bonuses as a period enhancement to all allies on first turn.  Otherwise only provides them until next turn
Move 6: Speed Screen – Grants haste until next turn and generates aim, must be used as last action
Minor 1: Momentous Initiative – Gain initial bonuses until beginning of next turn.  Requires momentum
Minor 2: Perilous Ground – Follows ranged attack, flanks target
Minor 3: Scouted Aim – Alpha, generates aim.  Also enhances accuracy and quickens self as first action

Capstone Skill: New Beginning (Momentum Modifier) – If momentum is high enough, gain initial bonuses on turn, including ability to use scouted abilities.
